title: Baiyuan RAG Knowledge Platform: A Whitepaper on L1 Wiki + L2 RAG Hybrid Retrieval for Multi-Tenant AI SaaS
description:
A technical whitepaper documenting the engineering practice of building Baiyuan RAG Knowledge Platform (2024–2026), a multi-tenant knowledge retrieval infrastructure powering three Baiyuan product lines: Baiyuan AI Customer Service SaaS, Baiyuan GEO Platform, and Baiyuan PIF AI (Product Information File automation for cosmetics regulatory compliance).

Coverage: two-layer retrieval architecture (L1 Wiki — database-cached compiled summaries via LLM Wiki compiler; L2 RAG — pgvector + BM25 + Reciprocal Rank Fusion hybrid retrieval), three-layer tenant isolation (PostgreSQL RLS + application-layer KB scoping + audit-log tables), streaming answers with tenant-aware chat gateway, human-operator handoff loop, deep integration patterns with Baiyuan GEO (brand-entity co-referencing, Schema.org interlinking) and Baiyuan PIF (regulatory vertical for cosmetics documentation under Taiwan Cosmetic Hygiene and Safety Act).

v1.0.0 (this version): initial stable release of 12 chapters + 4 appendices in three languages — Traditional Chinese (zh-TW, ~45,000 characters), English (en), and Japanese (ja) — covering Ch 1 The Dark Forest of Enterprise Knowledge, Ch 2 System Overview, Ch 3 L1 Wiki Compiler, Ch 4 L2 RAG Retrieval, Ch 5 Fallback Economics, Ch 6 Tenant Isolation, Ch 7 Ingestion Pipeline, Ch 8 Streaming & Handoff, Ch 9 GEO Integration, Ch 10 PIF Integration, Ch 11 Case Studies, Ch 12 Limitations, plus Appendices A (Glossary), B (API), C (References), D (Figures).

Languages: Traditional Chinese, English, and Japanese — all complete through chapter 12 + 4 appendices.
